mapper.select: SELECT REPORT_NUM AS reportNumber, REPORT_REPORTER AS reportReporter, REPORT_REASON AS reportReason, REPORT_DATE AS reportDate, REPORT_REPORTED AS reportReported, REPORT_DESCRIPTION AS reportDescription FROM REPORT ORDER BY REPORT_NUM DESC
SELECT REPORT_REPORTER FROM REPORT WHERE REPORT_REPORTER = #{reportReporter} AND REPORT_REPORTED = #{reportReported}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT (REPORT_NUM, REPORT_REPORTER, REPORT_REASON, REPORT_DATE, REPORT_REPORTED, REPORT_DESCRIPTION) VALUES (NVL((SELECT MAX(REPORT_NUM)+1 FROM REPORT), 1), #{reportReporter}, #{reportReason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{reportReported}, #{reportDescription})
